evidence: start: Incident Report, Date/Time of the Issue: first occurrence began 08 Oct 2026 04:00 Pacific (PDT). | end: Incident Report, Incident Recurrence: the recurrence ended 09 Oct 2026 09:46 Pacific; total 18 h 11 min across both. | regions: Summary and Description of Impact: first window hit the whole us-central1 region, the recurrence only zone us-central1-b.
